description: Google Shopping. Scrape Google Shopping results via API and retrieve structured product listings with prices, ratings, and merchant data. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

cr.description: Limit results to one or more countries. Use country{XX} with | as delimiter (e.g. countryFR|countryDE).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country to use for the Google search. Two-letter country code (e.g. us for the United States, uk for United Kingdom, or fr for France). Default: "us".

google_domain.description: Google domain to use for the search. Defaults to google.com. Default: "google.com".

hl.description: Language to use for the Google search. Two or three-letter language code (e.g. en, es, fr), optionally followed by a region code (e.g. en-gb, es-419). Default: "en".

location.description: Location to localize results (e.g. New York, United States). Generates a UULE parameter automatically.

lr.description: Limit results to one or more languages. Use lang_{xx} with | as delimiter (e.g. lang_fr|lang_de).

page.description: Page number for pagination (1 = first page). Default: 1.

query.description: Query to search on Google Shopping (product name, brand, category).

safe.description: Adult content filter. active enables Google SafeSearch; off disables it. Omit to use Google default.

uule.description: Encoded location parameter (UULE). Use location instead if you don't have a pre-encoded value.

name: google_shopping
title: Google Shopping
